understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to reach the + goal gem by navigating horizontally and using gravity to fall through the level without landing on hazards.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shifted the player horizontally, after which gravity carried the player until landing or encountering an obstacle, hazard, or goal. CLICK targeted and removed clickable breakable blocks, sometimes opening a fall path and causing the player to drop immediately. Landing on spikes caused failure, while safe tiles supported the player. UNDO reverted the previous action.
